title: NBN maintenance – Kew POI (3KEW), VIC
current_summary: Planned maintenance at the NBN Kew POI (3KEW), VIC is complete. Services are operating normally.

cause.reason: NNI rehoming at the NBN Kew POI (3KEW)

updates.content: We will perform network maintenance at the NBN Kew POI (3KEW) between 3:00am and 6:00am AEDT on 6 October 2026. Services delivered via this POI may experience interruptions during the window (up to 3 hours total). This work involves rehoming network links at the POI. No action is required from customers. We will monitor the change and post an update once the maintenance is complete.
The maintenance window has commenced at 3:00am AEDT. Work is in progress and services delivered via the Kew POI (3KEW) may experience interruptions until approximately 6:00am AEDT.
The maintenance at the Kew POI (3KEW) was completed at 6:00am AEDT on 6 October 2026. No further impact is expected.
